title: manuscript-guard currency assessment record
description: literature/currency/replies/<id>.<n>.<reader>.yaml: what a reader says a reply in Word says of a proposal: that it `refuses` it, `agrees` with it, or says something `other`, with the reply's own words that say so. Written once by `references --assess` and sealed by `assessment_sha256`. A refusal from a person of authors.yaml answers the proposal; nothing else does.

reader.description: Who read the reply: a person, an agent session, or a model.

quote.description: The reply's words that say it, word for word.

reply_sha256.description: The seal of the reply record as it was read.

provenance.description: Where a model read it: the provider and the model.
